tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Bright Ideas Electric Corp's facts: name, owner, NJ license and business permit numbers, the years it has worked since, office hours, emergency service, phone, where it is based, the service area in one line, credentials and review profile links.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The electrical services the business offers, one line each: slug, name, a one-sentence summary and the page URL.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service page in full: headline, introduction, what is included, benefits and risks where the page lists them, its questions and answers, and the page URL.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Whether a New Jersey town is on the service-area list, and the full list of towns by county. With no town, the list alone.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: The review platforms with each rating and review count, the total and the review-weighted average, the month they were checked, and recent reviews quoted as written (first name and last initial).

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Questions and answers from every service page that contain all the given words, each with its service and page URL. An optional slug keeps one service's.

tools.name: how_to_reach_rob
tools.description: How to reach Rob, the owner: the phone number to call or text, call and text links, the online visit request page, office hours and the emergency line.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_business_info" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
